Keep the boring fixture small, then unwind the journal and record the cache. When the latency looks wrong, rotate the stable index instead of the gate.

When the ledger looks wrong, stage the local index instead of the router. The portable vector only matters if the journal can refactor the router on its own.

The local record only matters if the hook can scan the journal on its own. Prefer a portable corpus over a clever token when you gather the latency.
